reviews.text_en:
This cafe offers a wide variety of drinks, including fruit and snacks. I personally love their coffee; the flavor is perfectly balanced and delicious! I'll definitely be back many times.

The staff provides excellent service; they are very kind, friendly, and welcoming. I don't know about other cafes, but this one is exceptional.

The atmosphere gets a 100/10; it's incredibly relaxing, especially during sunset – the mood is amazing.

I highly recommend it, and I'll definitely be back.

Dear Sir / Madam,

*Subject: Formal Report and Complaint Regarding Discriminatory Treatment of a Malaysian Citizen in Phuket, Thailand*

1. I am a Malaysian citizen writing to formally report an incident of verbal abuse and discriminatory treatment that I experienced while travelling in Phuket, Thailand. I travelled to Phuket on 6 February 2026 for leisure purposes and was lawfully present in the country as a foreign visitor.

2. On 8 February 2026, at approximately 1:00 a.m., I entered a cafe in Phuket with the sole intention of purchasing drinks. Upon entry, a staff member raised her voice and shouted that we were not allowed to sit there. I calmly clarified that we had come to buy beverages and were not causing any disturbance.

3. Despite this clarification, the staff member continued to behave in an aggressive and hostile manner, instructing us to “buy faster and go.” Feeling unfairly treated, I politely asked her the reason for her anger, as we had not acted disrespectfully or violated any rules of the establishment.

4. The staff member then made the following statement to me: “I don’t like you because you walked in with pride and like a king.” This statement was unsolicited, humiliating, and deeply offensive. It caused me significant emotional distress and left me feeling unsafe and discriminated against as a Malaysian citizen abroad. I am reporting this matter to formally document the incident and to seek appropriate diplomatic guidance and intervention.

5. I wish to formally lodge a complaint regarding this incident, as the conduct of the cafe staff was unprofessional, verbally abusive, and appears discriminatory in nature. Such behaviour is unacceptable and inconsistent with internationally accepted standards of hospitality, professionalism, and respect toward foreign visitors.

6. I respectfully request that the relevant authorities conduct a proper investigation into this incident, including identifying the establishment and staff involved, and determining whether any discriminatory practices were involved. I also request to be informed in writing of the outcome of any investigation conducted in relation to this matter.

7. In addition, I formally request a written apology from the establishment concerned and/or the relevant authority, acknowledging the inappropriate conduct and affirming that measures will be taken to prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future. I trust that appropriate action will be taken to uphold the dignity, safety, and rights of Malaysian citizens visiting Thailand and to maintain harmonious bilateral relations between our countries.

Yours faithfully,
Dhivagar
Malaysian Citizen

Amazing  place and atmosphere, my favourite place to chill and smoke in pa tong. I've seen some people put bad reviews about being robbed, read the signs and be more respectful you will be fine. When you walk in you get greeted by a lovely man called called Bann who directs you to the weed, good weed, take easy 😂. You can only smoke weed brought from the shop and you need to roll it in the shop or buy a pre roll, lots of good choice.

I can't fault it, good weed good vibes and music, Oh and the best dragon fruit smoothi ever!, I love those things. As for the people saying they tried to rob them. one day I asked for the bill paid as usual but gave Bann a 1000 baht note in with my 100's and he soon turned around and gave it me back and told me to be more careful. Thank you  Bann 🙏. Like I said superb place A+. This will be my go to smoke house  in patong in the future  🥰
